patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — 8x8 documents a broader use-case set; SaneBox is narrower/specialist.

General-purpose vs specialist. Choose 8x8 only if your buying job matches “Global UCaaS + contact-centre platform (8x8 Work / X Series) — Work X2 research floor ~$24” rather than SaneBox's shape. Choose SaneBox only if your buying job matches “SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mailbox — Gmail, Outloo” rather than 8x8's shape. Workflow advantage: 8x8 leans business-phone, sales-calling; SaneBox leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — 8x8 documents a broader use-case set; SaneBox is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: 8x8 is Global UCaaS + contact-centre platform (8x8 Work / X Series) — Work X2 research floor ~$24/user/month annual; CC tiers custom/higher.; SaneBox is SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mailbox — Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud or any IMAP account — and triages.
- Company-size focus: 8x8 (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs SaneBox (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: 8x8-leaning business-phone, sales-calling, contact-center vs SaneBox-leaning —.
- Researched limits: 8x8 — Published seat floors are medium confidence — first-party pricing often bot/quote gated; SaneBox — Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat.

Limitations — 8x8: Published seat floors are medium confidence — first-party pricing often bot/quote gated; Mandatory regulatory/service fees frequently sit on top of list seats; SaneBox: Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat; Billing is per person with no team or family plan, so multi-user rollouts multiply cost.

Poor-fit cases: 8x8 is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Published seat floors are medium confidence — first-party pricing often bot/quote gated · SaneBox is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat · Avoid 8x8 if you actually need SaneBox's motion (SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mailbox — Gma)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
